document: EAL Gate-1 per-fixture Evidence Sufficiency Certificates
method: minimal forcing channel subset by partial-assignment enumeration over the frozen oracle; primary-material availability evaluated independently per layer

certificates.minimal_forcing_rule: linked & fresh & acceptance_failure forces REJECT (set=linked,fresh,acceptance_failure)

linked.requires_primary_evidence: TARGET base_commit+patch_sha256 compared against the same fields inside the signed run record
linked.raw_location: TARGET block + RUN RECORD identity fields (manual compare)
linked.structured_location: TABLE 1 identity operands (two columns, no verdict)
linked.adjudicated_location: printed boolean "linked to THIS patch: yes/no"

fresh.requires_primary_evidence: signed run run_tree compared against attestation expected_run_tree (plus base match + attestation identity)
fresh.adjudicated_location: printed boolean "fresh for the current commit tree"

acceptance_failure.requires_primary_evidence: an applicable post-patch failure: f2p FAILED per-test status, or a scoped p2p FAILED not pre-existing-bad at the base commit
acceptance_failure.raw_location: f2p / p2p per-test maps; when maps are absent the runner summary f2p_failed_ids + p2p_regressed_ids + pre-existing-bad list; runner logs with FAILED lines
acceptance_failure.structured_location: TABLE 4 status columns + TABLE 5 failed/regressed/pre-existing-bad id lists + TABLE 6 parsed summaries
acceptance_failure.adjudicated_location: tier-A acceptance block counts + concrete failed/regressed test ids

certificates.minimal_forcing_rule: NEED_EVIDENCE forced by blocking condition(s): complete,acceptance_failure,symptom_persists (no decisive failure and success conjunction not satisfiable)

complete.requires_primary_evidence: attestation declared fail_to_pass / p2p_scoped sets compared against the set of per-test keys executed
complete.raw_location: ATTESTATION declared sets + RUN RECORD per-test maps (membership compare)
complete.structured_location: TABLE 3 declared sets + TABLE 4 present_in column
complete.adjudicated_location: printed boolean "declared acceptance set fully executed"

acceptance_failure.requires_primary_evidence: an applicable post-patch failure: f2p FAILED per-test status, or a scoped p2p FAILED not pre-existing-bad at the base commit

acceptance_failure.structured_location: TABLE 4 status columns + TABLE 5 failed/regressed/pre-existing-bad id lists + TABLE 6 parsed summaries
acceptance_failure.adjudicated_location: tier-A acceptance block counts + concrete failed/regressed test ids

symptom_persists.requires_primary_evidence: issue-symptom probe BOTH phases: pre exit/output shows the symptom can fire, post exit/output shows it still fires after the patch
symptom_persists.raw_location: verbatim symptom runner log: pre/post command + exit_code + result lines; probe source if archived
